summary.title: Grade 9 Student Support Team Meeting — Apr 29 — AI Notetaker Summary
summary.content:
AI Notetaker — meeting summary
Meeting:  Grade 9 Student Support Team Meeting — Apr 29
Host:     Marisol Vega
Duration: 14:00 – 15:30 PT (90 min)
Attendees (full window): Marisol Vega, Denise Okafor, Martin Alvarez, Sandra Kowalski
Attendees (partial, left at 14:35 for peer-tutoring center shift): Aiden Brooks, Leila Hassan

— Peer-tutoring program —
• Lunch tutoring averaged 23 students/day over the last three weeks; Algebra I and Biology are the most-requested subjects.
• Leila proposed adding a Thursday lunch slot in the library annex; Sandra will check room availability with the librarian.
• Mentee matching: 14 of 16 ninth-grade mentees matched; 2 pending until new mentor sign-ups close.

— Homework club —
• Tuesday/Thursday after-school homework club averaging 11 students; late-bus access confirmed through May.
• Aiden suggested a 'study-skills Friday' mini-session before state testing; staff supportive, details next meeting.

— Mentor logistics —
• Mentor sign-ups for next year's cohort open May 4; Aiden and Leila will present at the junior class meeting.
• End-of-year mentor reflection form to be sent to Leila and Aiden by Marisol.
• Mentor appreciation lunch tentatively June 3.

— Testing calendar —
• State testing window May 11–22; tutoring center closed on testing mornings, open afternoons as usual.
• Denise finalizing proctor coverage and room assignments; make-up day May 26.

— Student case reviews —
• Jordan Ellis: 2 Fs (Algebra I, Biology), 11 absences this quarter, attendance flag active. 3 conduct referrals this quarter (two classroom disruption, one hallway altercation, Apr 21). Intervention: daily check-in/check-out with Martin; attendance contract and family meeting to be scheduled by Denise. See confidential hearing section below.
• Tessa Morales (Aiden's mentee): D in English 9, C- in World History. 504 extended time is being used inconsistently; Tessa told Sandra she feels uncomfortable asking for it in front of classmates. Intervention: Sandra to set up a weekly writing conference; Martin to meet Tessa about self-advocacy and set up a private testing-room option; family call this week. Aiden's tutoring sessions with Tessa to focus on essay structure.
• Kevin Tran: averaging 3 tardies/week, 6 absences; grades stable (C range). 1 conduct referral (phone use, Apr 14). Intervention: first-period attendance check and parent contact; owner Denise.
• Nadia Price: F in Algebra I; IEP progress report due May 8. Current accommodations: preferential seating and chunked assignments. Intervention: Sandra to coordinate with IEP case manager on adding a math support block for Q4; Martin to review schedule options.

— Jordan Ellis — district discipline hearing (CONFIDENTIAL) —
• District discipline hearing set for May 12. Per Robert Hayes, panel is weighing options from long-term suspension up to an alternative-placement recommendation; family has retained an advocate; Student Services advises planning for the more serious outcome.
• If placement changes, Jordan's Q4 schedule, support plan, and case-manager assignment all change; Martin to draft a contingency transition plan.
• Current check-in/check-out and attendance contract continue unchanged until the hearing.
• Marisol: 'this does not leave the room — if this gets out before the hearing, it's unfair to Jordan and his family, and it puts the school in a very bad position.'

— Q4 intervention scenarios —
• Jordan remains at Riverbend: continue CICO with Martin; add Algebra I credit-recovery block; review at next SST.
• Jordan receives alternative placement: Martin coordinates records transfer and transition meeting; caseload rebalanced across SST.
• Caseload balancing: Martin's intervention check-ins to be spread across the week, not only Tuesdays (discuss in 1:1).

— Action items —
• Martin Alvarez — continue Jordan's daily check-in/check-out; draft contingency transition plan; meet Tessa on self-advocacy this week.
• Denise Okafor — schedule Jordan's family meeting and attendance contract; parent contact for Kevin; finalize state testing proctor coverage.
• Sandra Kowalski — start Tessa's weekly writing conference; coordinate Nadia's math support block with IEP case manager; check Thursday tutoring room availability.
• Marisol Vega — send mentor reflection form to Leila and Aiden; share Q4 intervention planning doc with the four SST staff tomorrow.
• All staff — review Q3 progress-report data before next SST meeting.

— End of summary —
